howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.heading:
Your browser does the work.
Not a server.
howItWorks.description: Other tools upload your files to a server, process them remotely, and send the results back. That takes time, and it means your files leave your device. bnto runs entirely in your browser. Processing happens on your machine in milliseconds. Nothing is uploaded. Nothing leaves.

noCatch.label: No catch
noCatch.heading:
Free recipes that stay free.
Open source you can verify.
noCatch.description: No signup. No watermarks. No daily caps. No ‘20 free compressions per month.’ Your browser does all the processing, so it costs us nothing to run. We’ll never put a meter on it. The engine is open source and MIT licensed. You can read every line.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Everything runs in your browser using Rust compiled to WebAssembly. Your files are processed on your device and never uploaded anywhere. Future premium recipes may use server-side processing for things browsers can’t do, like AI or video.
faq.a2: Yes. Every recipe that runs in your browser is free, unlimited, forever. No signup, no watermarks, no quality reduction, no daily caps. We will never put limits on browser-based recipes.
faq.a3: Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP, and TIFF for compression, resizing, and format conversion. Data: CSV files for cleaning and column renaming. Files: any file type for batch renaming. More node types are coming.
faq.q4: Can I build my own recipes?
faq.a4: Yes. The visual recipe editor lets you compose nodes into multi-step pipelines. Chain a resize into a format conversion into a compression, all in one recipe. Save your recipes and reuse them anytime.
faq.a5: Yes. The entire engine and web app are MIT licensed. You can inspect the source code, verify how recipes work, or contribute.
faq.a6: All browser-based recipes are free and unlimited. No signup, no caps. A Pro tier is planned for features that require server-side processing (AI, video, shell commands), persistence, and team collaboration.
faq.a7: No. Drop your files and run any recipe immediately. Create an account if you want to save custom recipes or access execution history.
faq.q8: Can I process multiple files at once?
faq.a8: Yes. Drop as many files as you want. bnto processes them all in a single batch. Results download as a ZIP when there are multiple output files.
